description: Limits the status-watcher agent's Bash use to a single foreground sleep, so a poller cannot run any other command or background its wait.

hooks.command: tr -d '\n' | awk 'match($0, /"agent_type" *: *"outsystems:status-watcher"/) && (!match($0, /"command" *: *"sleep [1-9][0-9]*"/) || match($0, /"run_in_background" *: *true/)) { print "Denied: status-watcher may run no Bash command except exactly sleep <seconds>, run in the foreground. Poll with your status tools, and use Bash only to wait between polls." > "/dev/stderr"; exit 2 }'
